title: The Heritage Keel
logline: A bankrupt drydock master tries to protect an antique survey keel from the scrap gantries, hiding that its core contains a fortune in unrefined ore.

roles.description: Runs the oldest manual repair cradle in the belt; deaf in one ear and fiercely defensive of historic spaceframes.
Buys decommissioned hulls for orbital cutting mills; tracks salvage margins to the fourth decimal place.
A century-old beryllium-bronze exploration keel sitting on cradle blocks awaiting cutting torches.
A cavernous unpressurized scrap dock ringed with cutting gantries and magnetic cranes.

public_situation: The belt's oldest orbital slipway faces foreclosure, and creditors have marked an uncatalogued exploration keel for scrap cutting.
private_truth: The keel core contains unrefined cuprite alloys deposited during an ancient deep-field survey, which {role:dock_foreman} hid to keep the cradle solvent.

beats.public_change: The scrapyard posts an urgent procurement notice for industrial ferrite to meet immediate structural quotas.

missions.reason: He needs bulk ferrite delivered immediately to satisfy an overdue maintenance bond before bailiffs arrive with cutting permits.
missions.private_fact: He is stalling the creditors while trying to arrange a private metallurgical appraisal for the keel.

beats.public_change: Creditors reject the bond extension and send an ultrasonic assessor to certify the keel for destruction.

missions.reason: She wants an independent spectral scan of the keel's structural lattice to confirm whether the dock foreman falsified the density logs.
missions.private_fact: She suspects the alloy is enriched and plans to pocket the smelter margin without crediting the dock's debt ledger.

player_choice.prompt: The scan proves the keel contains rare cuprite veins that could clear the dock's debts or make the scrap broker wealthy.

options.label: Hand the raw telemetry to the dock foreman to negotiate a debt settlement
Deliver the assay directly to the scrap broker to trigger an immediate auction
Certify the keel as worthless slag to preserve it from cutting gantries

beats.public_change: Smelting tenders gather at the yard perimeter as the foreman attempts to transport the enriched core before seizures take effect.

missions.reason: He needs a trusted courier to take the cut alloy samples to the station assay registry before the broker can impound the cradle.
missions.private_fact: He intends to surrender his operating charter in exchange for full debt clearance for his retired yard crew.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot registers the alloy samples, proving the keel's value and clearing the dock's balance sheet.
resolutions.summary: {role:dock_foreman} surrenders the enriched keel to settle the cradle's arrears. The yard stays open under new management, and the old crew receives their severance.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved an old survey keel held enough rare cuprite to buy out an entire shipyard.

resolutions.reached_by: The broker receives the assay report or intercepts the samples, liquidating the cradle.
resolutions.summary: {role:survey_keel} is cut into salvage ingots. {role:scrap_broker} claims a windfall commission while the historic yard is permanently shuttered.

consequences.public_summary: An antique exploration keel was cut up for industrial scrap after creditors foreclosed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the keel as worthless slag, causing creditors to abandon foreclosure as unprofitable.
resolutions.summary: Creditors abandon the claim, leaving the historic keel untouched in the cradle. {role:dock_foreman} maintains the quiet shrine, though operating funds remain critically tight.

loose_threads.detail: The drydock foreclosure lien lists an offshore holding trust that acquired the mortgage four days before default.
The inspector's ultrasonic spectrometer casing bears an inspection seal with an invalid registry checksum.

radio_hooks: Historic shipyard cradle facing foreclosure after century of continuous service.
Belt scrap auctions hit record volume as obsolete hulls are cleared for berth space.
Creditors demand immediate cutting of uncatalogued survey relic in {system}.

voice_direction.dock_foreman: Speaks in short, gravelly sentences with long pauses between clauses. Avoids mentioning the monetary value of metals, referring only to structural integrity.
voice_direction.scrap_broker: Crisp, courteous, and rapid. Uses legal jargon to deflect complaints and never raises her tone even when issuing ultimatums.
